details:
First of all, thank you for all that you guys do and Some things on this list might already be implemented and im just not aware. 

1. More badges -

Community badge: This badge can be given to one Users collectively, After so many users have given this badge to a single user, it will show up in the badge receivers badge's sections.  This badge is given to a user who is helpful, kind and respectful. 

World Builder badge: This badge is given to a User who has uploaded three or more worlds that have been well populated.  

Gamer badge: This badge is given to users who make Game worlds that are well populated.

2. World Age verification - World owners who make their world 18+ will not show up for any one who has not submitted their ID to VRC, Or have but are confirmed to be under 18.

3. VRC+ Customizable home world - Not everyone has the skills to build a world. So why not give them some Home world options? Place object around your world and they will stay where you left them. Change the wall color, Add some new music, Add some games. Maybe some lights. Now there will be a limit on how much you can add and all of it will come from a VRC library.  

4. VRC+ phone - Call or text other users on your friends list. When you are using the phone, A phone icon will show up above your head letting other know you are in a call. You can black calls and text from any user.
title: Many ideas
